children: NKGen Biotech expanded its financing with AlpineBrook Capital GP I, executing a Fourth Amendment to its Secured Convertible Loan Agreement and issuing a new $1,050,500 secured convertible note at a $0.08 conversion price. The note includes a $95,500 facilitation fee, providing $955,000 in net proceeds, and the company increased total consideration shares to 13,304,114 to be delivered over 30 months. NKGen also issued a 10-year warrant at a $0.08 exercise price with a 9.99% ownership cap and cashless exercise features. Additionally, NKGen entered a Voting Agreement with key holders to support an increase in authorized shares to enable conversions and warrant exercises.
